name: @adkinn/fifth-edition-srd-mcp
description: stdio MCP server for SRD 5.2.1 monsters and conditions (2024 rules)

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.build:test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js

author: Adam Kinney <npm@adamkinney.com> (https://adamkinney.com)
